description: Bizuayeu's derived checkpoint of internlm/Sage-S2.1-Flash (GLM-5.3-Flash architecture, 320B total, 18B active) for two GB10 systems: routed experts of layers 3 to 44 and the MTP layer in NVFP4 (csf_32x2_v1 scales, quantized from BF16 with no calibration), MLA attention and shared experts in the official FP8 release's bytes, dense MLPs of layers 0 to 2 in MXFP8, and KDA attention, lm_head, embeddings, router and the vision tower in BF16. 183.8 GB in 144 files; KL 0.0426 and top-1 agreement 93.56% against BF16 on 128 documents. Not an InternLM or Z.AI release.
